checks.evidence: Test 1 step 1 checks that the gateway's p99 response time is at most 20 ms in absolute terms. It does not measure a baseline or compare against one, so it is not equivalent to 'baseline + at most 20 ms'.

invented: Test 2 sends 3,000 rps and expects p99 above 20 ms with the system reporting it; the requirement states no overload behaviour and no reporting.
The 10-second duration of the load is not stated in the requirement and is not listed as an assumption.
